nodes.answer: Perry, P., Wood, S., & Fernie, J. (2015) discuss the insights into corporate social responsibility in garment sourcing networks from the perspectives of factory management in Sri Lanka.

nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What challenges do buyer organizations face in maintaining environmental sustainability and corporate social responsibility in sustainable fashion supply chains?
nodes.answer: Buyer organizations face challenges in maintaining environmental sustainability and corporate social responsibility in sustainable fashion supply chains due to the lack of transparency of the origin of outsourced supplies, which can lead to ethical issues such as child labour, workers' rights exploitation, and absence of hygiene standards.
